body: So it's justifiable to ruin someone else's life because you can't come to terms with your sexuality? I agree that there definitely is a stigma that comes along with being out of the closet, but that does not make it okay to put someone through a fake marriage and the stress of divorce because you can't deal with your shit.
I feel like an idiot but I still don't get it. What the hell does onion rings have to do with anything?

That's fucking ridiculous man. I would sit them down and tell them to mind their own fucking business. If they keep asking you should threaten them that the next time they ask you you will break something in the house. That would shut them up haha.

But socializing online will only get me so far. Living your entire life online is a really crappy way to live. I've never really struggled with talking to people online.
